sources.entry: Diagrammaton - Diagrammaton converts natural language descriptions into fleshed out diagrams. #free

summary.name: Diagrammaton
summary.one_liner: A Figma/FigJam plugin that turns natural-language descriptions into diagrams, but it is no longer maintained or supported.
use_cases: Turning a written process description into a flowchart
Mapping a mobile app sign-in or auth flow
Structuring rough ideas into a diagram for a design team
summary.what_it_does: Diagrammaton takes a natural-language description, such as an auth flow or sign-up process, and generates a diagram inside Figma or FigJam. Users work incrementally, refining an unstructured idea into a more logical structure. Setup required an OpenAI API key, which was exchanged on diagrammaton.com for a free license code that was pasted into the plugin. The page lists example prompts and a version history, with the latest version (14, May 14, 2024) switching the GPT-4 option to GPT-4 Omni. The page states the plugin is no longer maintained and may stop working at any time. Several comments report API key and Google sign-in validation failures.
notable: Requires an OpenAI API key plus a license code from diagrammaton.com
Offers GPT-4 Omni option as of version 14
No longer maintained as of the page's listing
caveats: No longer supported or maintained; may stop working at any time
Requires a personal OpenAI API key and a diagrammaton.com license code with Google sign-in
Users in comments reported API key validation and Google sign-in login failures
